headline: AI Delivery and Implementation | Client Rollouts, Workflow and Policy Scoping, LLM Evaluation | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: I spent four years at Greenway Health running software implementations for close to 200 client practices: discovery, workflow documentation, configuration, go-live and the questions that come after it. I was the clinical lead on Greenway's AI-first EHR, where I scoped which tasks an AI agent could take over and where a human had to stay in charge. I grade frontier models against rubrics I write, and I built Roovero and Pawlentine myself with Claude Code and Codex. Roovero has paying pilot clients.
greenway_bullets: Ran implementations for close to 200 client practices, several at a time, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, go-live and follow-up, as the client's main contact.

Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: mapped workflows, scoped where agentic automation could take routine work off staff and where review had to stay, and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Worked through ambiguous client rules and edge cases with each practice, wrote them down, and turned recurring ones into feature requests that product teams built; many shipped.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on new workflows.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: client implementations, discovery, workflow and rule documentation, scope and timelines, go-live, issue triage, client communication
agentic workflow scoping, LLM evaluation and scoring rubrics, prompt design, multi-model API routing, AI-assisted build with Claude Code and Codex
React, GitHub, n8n, Firebase, Next.js, webhooks and billing integrations
thesis_html: AI delivery is mostly edge cases. I've spent four years closing them.
